rationale: Automatic admission additionally requires the canonical PBE, PBE0, B3LYP or r2SCAN electronic composition and default Treutler/Lebedev/NWChem grid. Generated split hybrids (including M06-2X), custom mixtures and other grids retain the incumbent; explicit 1 is experimental and does not bypass owner/final-state gates. Eligible strict-FP64 restricted single-iteration owners may replace only the conservative AO-maximum margin with the existing complete canonical final-state proof on the current physical F[D]. Energy, density-change, spin-RMS and all final-state acceptance gates remain unchanged. Numerical rejection continues from the intact density proposal without publishing borrowed orbital scratch; driver/solver failures propagate. Explicit 0 restores the incumbent policy. Pure-J DF is eligible; Fast, mixed, fitted exchange, range/nonlocal, UKS, incremental, ECP, chunks and missing resident workspace/library retain the incumbent. No new persistent numeric storage is required.
revisit_condition: Qualify other solver/provider/precision/lifetime domains independently. Preserve the unchanged final canonical-density test, failed-proof continuation and token-bound force validation. Complete cold/warm timings and semantic work, including rejected probes, must support any performance claim; unchanged-iteration populations may incur a small extra proof cost.
